hooks.text: 每次掷骰都在继续贪分与及时存分之间押注
hooks.excerpt: Dice Have No Eyes is a dice-rolling Balatro-like fever dream about greed management. Every roll carries a chance for glory. But every roll carries a risk of bust.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 给骰子喂饺子并收集改写规则的饰品
hooks.excerpt: Feed your dice dumplings, collect game bending trinkets, roll too much and lose it all.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 通关后替换强化骰子，用饰品拼出破格协同
hooks.excerpt: Improve and swap your dice with each cleared level. Collect trinkets and discover broken synergies.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
